Crisp fighting-game PIXEL ART, hard stepped edges, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading matching the current game. Exactly one complete machine in each cell, consistent chassis proportions and scale. Face angled toward RIGHT. Pure solid magenta #ff00ff background; no labels, grid lines, floor, shadows, trails or detached effects. Generous empty margins; complete spikes and casing wholly visible. ONLY the LARGE FOREGROUND FLOATING MACHINE in image 1. This character is named ᐯᕬᑌᗞᖇᕮᗋᕬ. A blue-violet handheld-console-shaped sentient machine: broad angled rectangular chassis, tilted recessed rectangular screen with yellow diagonal reflection, one enormous round yellow eye and a smaller yellow eye with black pupils, broad yellow toothy grille along lower edge, circular recessed buttons, small screws, and blue triangular top spikes. Preserve the exact asymmetry and face layout. Exclude the small blue creature in the background and all background yellow/black framing. This is ONE machine, NOT a twin. It has NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO ARMS, NO HANDS, no humanoid torso. Its chassis remains intact in every drawing. Extend only the cropped machine casing conservatively. All movement is anti-gravity hovering, pitch/roll/yaw, squash-free tilts and chassis thrusts. No standing, walking or kicking anatomy. No invented human limbs.

Row8 throw release with forward pitch; screen charging posture; screen projected-forward cast posture; triumphant wide upward machine tilt. No effects drawn. Keep chassis connected and rigid; poses convey different attitudes through rotation and screen/eyes.
